name: Heroism
text: You stand triumphant over your fallen foe and feel their essence enter your own. Each Persona Draws Psyche equal to their Willpower.

name: Injury
text: You fall from a great height as the landscape undulates beneath your feet. Each Persona Discards Psyche Cards valued higher than their Willpower.

name: Chase
text: The thing behind you seems to be gaining on you. Spawn 1 Encounter on each Persona-occupied Landscape.

name: Recovery
text: The sun breaks through the misty clouds. Return 1 Card per Persona.

name: Well Being
text: Suddenly you feel as if things are exactly the way they should be. All Personae Draw 3 Psyche.

name: Quiet
text: Everything remains, nothing changes. Nothing Happens.

name: Betrayal
text: The person who's been helping you suddenly vanishes with your Objects. Each Persona Represses Objects equal to Willpower minus Lucidity.

name: Travel
text: You find yourself flying over the Patchwork Dreamscape. Next Explore Phase, each Persona may move anywhere for free.

name: The Final Recurrence
text: All hopes and fears flood the Dreamscape. Remaining Archetypes must be Met with 12 Psyche Plays using opposing suits.

name: Final Recurrence: THETA
text: You relax. Forget 8 Edge Landscapes. All Personae Draw 2 Psyche.

name: Final Recurrence: ALPHA
text: Everything is clear. Forget 4 Edge Landscapes. All Personae Draw 1 Object.

name: You Never Wake Up
text: You Lose. Bottom of Final Recurrence Deck.
